changelog: v0.9.2 — fix loa3 JWT cache poisoning: exp is part of the libsecret attribute set, so every unlock stored a NEW item and reads matched the oldest (expired) token, making vault-run report 'no fresh loa3 JWT' right after a successful vault-unlock.
